method.fixture: 600 directories and 9600 files, identical for all children
method.memory: PROCESS_MEMORY_COUNTERS_EX peak working set and peak pagefile usage of whole Node child; additive comparison uses paired peak working set differences
method.cpu: GetProcessTimes user plus kernel cumulative CPU of whole Node child
method.limitations: JIT, GC, process startup, filesystem caches and sample variance affect results; independent process peaks need not coincide in time. This does not measure whole-app memory; no per-walk process is started.
